page.overview:
Who is Occtis Tachonis?

is a human Hollow One wizard played by Alexander Ward in Campaign Four.

Occtis is a young man, standing 5'11" and thin, with olive skin, dark hair, and bright green eyes. He wears dark, nobleman's clothing that is clean but worn, with various items and implements hanging from his belt or in the many pockets inside his coat, and has a book strapped to his leg. He is accompanied by a small, mostly white fox named Pincushion. After his resurrection he became a little bit more pale and gaunt, and his eyes acquired a supernatural glow that only dims if he is fully unconscious. In the following days he decided to wear more generic clothes instead of the characteristic Tachonis black, although he kept his coat because all of his components were in its pockets.

According to Julien Davinos, ever since he was young Occtis had a certain look that was very distinctive in his family.

As the sole member of his family without sorcerous magical powers, Occtis grew up feeling as though he was unable to fulfill his family's expectations for him. When he joined Thaisha Lloy on her expedition into Venatus, he began to think people cared about him as a human being, but when his family killed him for their own purposes and he became a Hollow One, it seemed that they valued him solely because of what he is, and that he was only a means to an end. It confirmed to him his lifelong sense of loneliness. Episode 2 Discussing Up To C4E18|01:10:46|Tale Gate Episode 2: Discussing Up To C4E18}} Due to his life circumstances, he has never had a way of processing his emotions in a healthy way, although he is slowly learning to do so with his new group of friends, since he feels like they do care for him, even if it is somewhat "conditional" because his skills are useful.
